

// package main






type Void = u8;





trait Contract {


fn missing();





fn empty();





fn unit() -> (());





fn scalar(value: u8) -> (u8);





fn multiple() -> (u8, bool);





fn tuple() -> ((i32, i32));





fn nested(pair: (i32, i32), values: Result<Vec<(i32, i32)>, ()>, map: fn(i32, i32) -> (i32, i32)) -> ((i32, i32), u8);





fn Void() -> (Void);


}



fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

return;



    
}
